messages:
Maya: Quick vendor check — they said there's a 4-slot burst window tomorrow 13:00–15:00 PST for APAC demo. Who needs GPUs? @Priya @Liam
Liam: I need 2x A100 for canary runs (30m each). Can we lock them? :raised_hands:
Priya: We need 1x H100 for perf sweeps, could start 13:30 instead of 13:00. If we shift, frees up a slot earlier.
Jordan: Might want 1 short L40s run at 14:00. Could use the spare slot.
VendorOpsBot: VendorOps: Confirmed 4 physical slots tomorrow 2026-03-18 13:00–15:00 PST. We can reserve up to 2x A100 + 2x H100 mix. Rack prep ETA 12:30. Cancellation policy: 48h no-penalty, <=12h before start incurs 50% fee.
Maya: Is partial release allowed (release one GPU mid-window)? How to do it?
VendorOpsBot: Partial releases supported; billing prorated by full hour. To update reservation use our API or update infra PR. Example curl: ```curl -X POST https://vendor.example/api/reserve -d '{"id":"VEND-...","release_gpus":1,"time":"2026-03-18T14:30:00-08:00"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $VEND_TOKEN'```
Liam: I'll prep k8s job with nodeSelector for a100; PR up: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/pull/764 (sets reservation tags).
Priya: If I shift to 13:30 I only need H100 until 14:30, so partial release makes sense.
Maya: OK I'll submit reservation for 2 A100 + 1 H100 now, leave last slot unreserved for Jordan to claim. @Jordan can you confirm you'll take it for L40s at 14:00?
Jordan: Confirmed, I'll claim the spare for 14:00 short test. Will post job link once scheduled.
InfraBot: Reservation request received. Request ID: pending-8423. Please add billing code: ENG-DEMO-Q2.
VendorOpsBot: Reservation created: VEND-20260318-789. Reserved: 2x A100 (nodepool: demo-west), 1x H100 (nodepool: demo-apac). One slot available. To modify reservation update PR infra/reservations#764 or DM VendorOps.
Liam: Nice. I'll tag the k8s jobs with reservation id.
Priya: Thanks everyone. Will coordinate warmup logs in #eng-infra and ping if schedule slips.
Maya: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with a calendar invite and reservation details.
